method: Read-only inventory. Each claim id corresponds to a tracked artefact that was opened and read. Fields are orthogonal: property (what is asserted), scope (what it ranges over), quantification (measurable form), identity (which candidate/artefacts it binds to), evidence (what is cited and whether it is present and reconstructable), verdict (what the present tree supports). No prose claim is upgraded above the evidence cited for it.

source_identity.tree_hash_rule: sha256 over canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators ',', ':') of sorted [relpath, size, sha256] entries, restricted to tracked files (git ls-files) under the named paths; this is the atlas_common.content_hash / phase7_courts._source_tree_digest rule applied to tracked files only

o7_withdrawal.finding: The pre-fix four-cell claim was withdrawn in a machine-readable revision. At commit cc2e5fa32, courts/phase18/interop/RECEIPT-o7.json carried status WITHDRAWN and withdrawn true. The current receipt (last changed at 5b04fa06f) records status ESTABLISHED, withdrawn false, and states that it supersedes the withdrawn revision 2 and the three pre-fix per-cell receipts. The current four per-cell receipts (RECEIPT-o7-AA/AB/BA/BB.json) record withdrawn false and carry the cell-level DSO digests. The old claim was not silently restored; it was replaced by a new run whose cells map the intended library.

court_tmp_log_paths.finding: 1,929 references to court/tmp/ appear in tracked JSON and Markdown; git ls-files court/tmp returns 0 files. The directory is excluded by .gitignore. Every such reference names evidence that cannot be reconstructed from a clean checkout unless the cited run is re-executed.

openssh_graduation_vs_adjudication.finding: evidence/SAFE-COMPATIBLE-openssh-b85c.json records a principal-decided SAFE_COMPATIBLE verdict for ssh and sshd at b85c. evidence/b85c-adjudication.json records NOT ESTABLISHED at the same candidate, and the graduation record itself preserves that dissent. The closure receipts cited by the graduation record carry verdict.safe_compatible=false, and evidence/FREEZE-b85c.json records the L7 replay as not_graduated. The pair is not a silent conflict: the graduation is a governance act over evidence whose own machine records say the candidate is not graduated.

t27_t29_receipts.finding: docs/ETP-TODO.md marks T27 and T29 DONE but neither row names a receipt file. T27 names no evidence path at all; T29 names courts/phase18/timing/run_bench_api.sh and court/tmp/t21/libcrypto.so.3, the latter untracked. Their evidence is the row prose (a commit-message-shaped narrative), not a committed receipt.

dso_digest_divergence.finding: The interop matrix cells link build B as ee7fa27c, while RECEIPT-o4.json, RECEIPT-o5.json and MANIFEST-o11-B.json name build B as 3c3a68c1. Other claim families name aaa32f21 (T19/T20 measurement DSO), 5d0f9098 (distribution DSO), fd25cc9e (tracked install), 06b5f338 (b85c candidate) and 1c03ec0a (runtime atlas). These are not interchangeable and the tree does not bind them to one build record.
